title: Max and Anna
text:
Anna has a dog. His name is Max. Max is brown and very happy. Every morning, Anna walks Max in the park.

In the park, there is a big lake. Max likes to swim in the lake. After the walk, Anna and Max go home. Anna is tired, but she is happy.

questions.text: What is the name of Anna's dog?
What does Max like to do in the lake?
What can we guess about Anna's feelings for Max?
options: She cares about him a lot

questions.text: Why might Anna be tired after the walk?
options: She stayed in bed all day
She was active outside with Max
She went to work for many hours

vocabulary.definition: a public place with grass and trees where people walk
a large area of water with land all around it

paragraph_translations: Anna ma psa. Ma na imię Max. Max jest brązowy i bardzo szczęśliwy. Każdego ranka Anna wyprowadza Maxa do parku.
W parku jest duże jezioro. Max lubi pływać w jeziorze. Po spacerze Anna i Max wracają do domu. Anna jest zmęczona, ale szczęśliwa.
